About us

Your marketing department, with skin in the game.

Why we started Rrjeti.

In Kosovo, marketing was always sold at a fixed price. The agency got paid the same every month, whether the business sold more or not.

We saw that as a gap. When you get paid the same regardless of results, there is no reason to give your best, and that makes agencies unaccountable.

With the 10% partnership, we have skin in the game too. We only grow when you grow, so we put far more energy into making results happen. That is what drives us every day.

Referrals
